en.title: Rick Riordan's Kane Chronicles Officially Coming to Disney+ as Series
en.summary: The beloved 'Kane Chronicles' book series is finally getting a live-action adaptation. Disney+ is developing the series with Rick Riordan himself at the helm.
en.body:
After years of anticipation and a previous Netflix deal that never materialized, **Rick Riordan**'s **'The Kane Chronicles'** series is officially heading to Disney+. The author, celebrated for bringing demigods and Greek mythology to life in the **'Percy Jackson'** universe, is set to develop this new live-action adaptation alongside **Angela Robinson**, known for her work on **'True Blood'** and **'The L Word'**. This collaboration promises an authentic vision for the Egyptian mythology-infused stories that have captivated readers worldwide.


## Bringing Ancient Egypt to Disney+

The **'Kane Chronicles'** trilogy, comprising **'The Red Pyramid'**, **'The Throne of Fire'**, and **'The Serpent's Shadow'**, follows siblings Carter and Sadie Kane as they discover their lineage as descendants of ancient Egyptian pharaohs and magicians. Their journey plunges them into a secret world of gods, monsters, and magical battles that echo through modern-day New York City. The series was previously in development as a film trilogy at Netflix, but the rights eventually reverted to Riordan, paving the way for this Disney+ venture. The involvement of both Riordan and Robinson as executive producers suggests a strong creative hand guiding the project, aiming to capture the spirit and depth of the novels for a new generation of viewers.


## Fan Reaction and Future Stakes

News of the adaptation has been met with palpable excitement from fans, many of whom have been campaigning for a faithful screen version for years. The journey from book to screen has been a long one, marked by the earlier Netflix project's stall. This official announcement, however, has reignited hopes for a successful adaptation that honors the source material. The success of this series could pave the way for further expansions within Riordan's literary universe on Disney+, potentially creating a larger interconnected franchise akin to what other platforms have achieved with popular book series. The stakes are high for both Disney+ and the creative team to deliver a narrative that satisfies long-time fans while attracting new audiences to the intricate world of Egyptian magic.


## What's Next

While specific casting and a firm release date are yet to be announced, the series is reportedly targeting a 2026 premiere. Fans will be eagerly awaiting further details regarding the production timeline and the first glimpses of how Carter and Sadie Kane's adventures will unfold on screen.
